title: VSCode settings.json description and ordering optimization (F-005)
description: Improve package.json contributes.configuration entries with logical ordering via 'order' property and enhanced descriptions. Base config gets order 1-10, providers 11-40, features.commitFormat 41-50, features.codeAnalysis 51-60, features.commitMessage 61-70, features.branchName 71-80, features.prSummary 81-90. Key settings descriptions add note about Webview UI availability.

criteria: Order values follow grouping: base.* 1-10, providers.* 11-40, features.commitFormat.* 41-50, features.codeAnalysis.* 51-60, features.commitMessage.* 61-70, features.branchName.* 71-80, features.prSummary.* 81-90
At least 3 key settings descriptions include webview UI note: 'Also configurable in the extension sidebar settings panel.'
No regression in existing settings display
Verify by: grep -c '"order"' src/package.json (count matches property count)
convergence.definition_of_done: VSCode Settings Editor shows dish-ai-commit settings in logical groups with improved descriptions

files.change: Add 'order' property to all configuration entries, enhance descriptions for key settings with Webview UI note

implementation.title: Add order property to all configuration entries
implementation.description: Add 'order' property to each configuration property in package.json contributes.configuration.properties following the grouping scheme.
modification_points: Add 'order' property to all ~25 base/providers/features configuration entries
Group ordering: base.* (1-10), providers.* (11-40), features by subcategory (41-90)
Each entry gets a unique sequential order within its group
logic_flow: List all configuration properties from contributes.configuration.properties
Categorize each into group (base, providers, features.commitFormat, etc.)
Assign order values following the specified ranges
Add order property to each entry in package.json

logic_flow: Identify key user-facing settings from each category

Keep existing description text intact, just append the note
